NEET UG Paper Leak: Court Orders Framing of Charges Against 14 Accused

A court has ordered that charges be framed against 14 accused in the NEET UG paper leak case. The Rouse Avenue Court will frame the charges on November 21 and will hear the case daily. The investigation is ongoing, with authorities tightening their grip on the accused.
